operation.source_intent: When page is greater than one, decrement the current comments page and reload the authoritative tenant/site-scoped WordPress comments GET. On the first page the control stays disabled.

laravel_runtime.semantics: The tenant/site-scoped Comments collection Previous button carries the source operation ID as a canonical alias alongside the existing generic collection Previous ID. It decrements page state only when page > 1 and fetches the authoritative comments endpoint with the current tenant and site context.
laravel_runtime.loading_error_empty_behavior: Previous is disabled on page one. A change of page triggers the scoped comments GET, and failures surface through the existing query error state without a success toast.

coverage: CommentsManager.razor PreviousPageClickedAsync source action and guarded decrement
Exact source operation ID on the real Previous pagination button
Authoritative tenant/site-scoped page decrement GET, disabled page one
Existing content.view forbidden and cross-tenant 404 assertions
No provider mutation or fake success
